deviation: Streamable is an Iterable and stream Supplier. Supplier-backed sources obtain a fresh stream each time. Implementors provide stream() until the lazy Iterable-to-Stream bridge is available. The D variadic factory retains a snapshot of its input array.
reason: The current Stream APIs cannot lazily pull from an arbitrary iterator. Copying the D variadic slice gives the streamable an owned sequence, including when the caller supplies a mutable array.
